description: A32/T32 (armeabi-v7a) ↔ A64 (arm64) disassembler / assembler / recompiler with Z3 formal equivalence verification

runtime_self_contained.impl: runtime/atomics_rt.S — LL/SC (ARMv8.0+), compiler-rt semantics, hidden symbols

pipeline: readelf — parse ELF32 LE armeabi-v7a .so / .o sections + symbols
decode — A32/T32 words → rearm IR (pure Rust, ARM ARM semantics)
translate — IR → A64 sequences (1:1 fixed register map, PC/LR modeled)
relocate — rewrite branch/call/literal targets to A64 offsets
emit — valid ELF64 AArch64 object (readelf/llvm-objdump clean)
verify — Z3 unsat equivalence proofs + LLVM differential on every word
bugs_fixed_by_differential: A32 BFX widthm1 is 5 bits at (20:16) — widths > 16 were undecodable
UMAAL + SMMUL/SMMLA/SMMLS families missing; CLREX missing
vshl-family N/M field SWAP (ARM ARM quirk)
vcge/vcgt decode swap; vqdmulh vs vqrdmulh split; vabd.f32 missing
A64 stxr missing 11111 marker; ldxr/ldxp missing L-bit (ldxr emitted STXR!)
A64 msr/mrs nzcv Rt at bits(4:0), not (9:5)
bfm N-bit for sf=1 — all 64-bit shifts/bitfields unallocated on real HW
fp1 opcode is 2 bits at (16:15) — fabs emitted fneg
fcmp E=bit4; fmsub/fnmadd bit15/21 swapped; conversions sf=bit31
encode_bitmask: whole-word rotation vs per-element — Z3 proofs were self-consistent but HW disagreed
QAbs/QNeg translator arms were binding variables, not enum variants — catch-all swallowed everything
FP 3-same arms were dead code (shadowed by integer arms)
ssat16/usat16: Q flag missed LO-half saturation; usat16 sign-extend source
usad8 SWAR mask polarity; sub8 signxor must AND with S8 markers
vld2x4 → two ld2 + add x16 expansion

bugs_found_by_pubg_differential: MOVS/ANDS (shifted register): shifter-carry bit extracted AFTER the flag-setting op destroyed the source (rd==rm)
ORNS.W (immediate) fallback encoded BICS instead of ORN for non-bitmask-encodable immediates
MUL/MLA/MLS/SMULL-family/SMLAWY/SMLAL/SDIV: PC operands (r15) read the x15 scratch instead of the pc+8 value
register-shifted Add/SBC: base PC materialization into x16 clobbered by the shift temp
rs==15 (PC as shift-amount register) now correctly unsupported instead of mistranslated
T32 BFI decode panicked on UNPREDICTABLE msb<lsb (data-in-text)
T32 SSAT/USAT sat_imm field read 6 bits instead of 5/4 (data-in-text width overflow)

tp_protection.discovered: libUE4.so .text/.rodata encrypted with per-byte XOR 0xDE (Tencent TP at rest)
tp_protection.recovered: static XOR key via statistical analysis (E/F-cond frequency, push-prologue cribs, BL-target verification)
tp_protection.proof: 94.6% of 119,233 exidx function starts decode to classic STMFD prologues; .rodata decodes to clean UTF-16LE UE4 strings

bugs_fixed_this_session: A32 conditional non-branch instructions (addeq/ldrne/...) were translated unconditionally — added b.<inv> guard-bracket veneer (T32-style) in the payload sweep
A32 B.cond fixups were patched as unconditional B, destroying the condition — now FixKind::Bcond (bit-exact cond preserved)
A32 B.cond >1MiB: translate emitted bcond with raw A32 offset -> "b.cond range" errors — now always placeholder + farset veneer
FPSCR flag lifetime: vcmp wrote A64 NZCV directly (any integer S-op would clobber before vmrs) — added x22 FP-flags shadow (mrs x22, nzcv after fcmp; msr nzcv, x22 on vmrs)
NEON Q-form ops emitted single A64 128-bit ops under the Dk->Vk[63:0] layout — WRONG (high halves garbage); now split into two D-form ops on (d,n,m)/(d+1,n+1,m+1)

by-element space (vmla/vmul/vqdmulh q,q,d[x]) was entirely MISDECODED as 3-different ops (AddL/AbsDiff garbage); implemented the b23=1/b6=1/b4=0 by-element decode + A64 by-element encoding (LLVM-verified bit-exact)
enc_movi defgh field was at bits(4:0) colliding with Rd — fixed to bits(9:5) (LLVM-verified)
enc_byelem index bits were wrong (sz=1 placeholder) — rewrote with LLVM-verified H/L layout
VmovImm Q-forms wrote only the low D register — now split over Dk/Dk+1
VMSR/VMRS full FPSCR: control bits now mirrored to FPCR (AHP/DN/FZ/RMode bit-aligned); Q via x20
exidx anchors added: 119k prel31 function starts seeded (mode from thumb bit)
A32 BLX imm now seeds thumb targets (mode switch)
sweep stops on undecodable words instead of poisoning the visited set (mode bleed-through fix)
VCVT/VCVT fixed-point, VMRS/VMSR, VMOV.I8/I16/I32/I64/F32/F64, VMVN, VMOV (core<->dreg pair) implemented (LLVM-verified encodings)
